description: This file defines a template-based utility for converting various types to their string representations, including support for Android-specific types, pointers, containers, and basic types. It also includes conditional compilation for Android NDK interfaces and other Android-specific headers.

classes.name: HasToStringMethod
classes.description: Detects if a type has a toString() method.

classes.name: HasToStringFunction
classes.description: Detects if a type has an overloaded toString() function.

classes.name: IsInstantiationOf
classes.description: Checks if a type is an instantiation of a given template.

classes.name: IsPointerLike
classes.description: Checks if a type is pointer-like (e.g., shared_ptr, optional, unique_ptr, sp).

classes.name: IsIterable
classes.description: Checks if a type is iterable (supports begin() and end()).

classes.name: TypeDependentFalse
classes.description: Helper for static_assert false in templates.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts various supported types to their string representation, with special handling for Android-specific types, pointers, containers, and basic types.
